FormOfTheBeast.Title: Form of the Beast
FormOfTheBeast.Prompt: {name} rages — manifest the bestial power within? Choose a natural weapon to take form until the rage ends.
FormOfTheBeast.BiteDescription: Your mouth transforms into a bestial muzzle or great mandibles. Once on each of your turns when you damage a creature with this bite, you regain hit points equal to your proficiency bonus, provided you have less than half your hit points when you hit.
FormOfTheBeast.ClawsDescription: Each of your hands transforms into a claw, usable as a weapon while it's empty. Once on each of your turns when you attack with a claw using the Attack action, you can make one additional claw attack as part of the same action.
FormOfTheBeast.TailDescription: You grow a lashing, spiny tail with reach. When a creature you can see within 10 feet hits you with an attack roll, you can use your reaction to roll a d8 and add it to your AC against that attack, possibly causing it to miss.

TotemSpirit.BearDescription: While raging, you have resistance to all damage except psychic damage.
TotemSpirit.ElkDescription: While you're raging and aren't wearing heavy armor, your walking speed increases by 15 feet.
TotemSpirit.EagleDescription: While you're raging and aren't wearing heavy armor, other creatures have disadvantage on opportunity attack rolls against you, and you can use the Dash action as a bonus action on your turn.
TotemSpirit.TigerDescription: While raging, you can add 10 feet to your long jump distance and 3 feet to your high jump distance.
TotemSpirit.WolfDescription: While raging, your friends have advantage on melee attack rolls against any creature within 5 feet of you that is hostile to you.

TotemicAttunement.BearDescription: While you're raging, any creature within 5 feet of you that's hostile to you has disadvantage on attack rolls against targets other than you or another character with this feature.
TotemicAttunement.EagleDescription: While raging, you have a flying speed equal to your current walking speed. This benefit works only in short bursts; you fall if you end your turn in the air and nothing else is holding you aloft.
TotemicAttunement.ElkDescription: While raging, you can use a bonus action during your move to pass through the space of a Large or smaller creature. That creature must succeed on a Strength saving throw (DC 8 + your proficiency bonus + your Strength modifier) or be knocked prone and take bludgeoning damage equal to 1d12 + your Strength modifier.
TotemicAttunement.TigerDescription: While raging, if you move at least 20 feet in a straight line toward a Large or smaller target right before making a melee weapon attack against it, you can use a bonus action to make an additional melee weapon attack against it.
TotemicAttunement.WolfDescription: While raging, you can use a bonus action to knock a Large or smaller creature prone when you hit it with a melee weapon attack.

WildSurge.ExplodingSpiritDescription: Until your rage ends, you can use a bonus action on each of your turns to summon another exploding spirit. At the end of the turn it appears, the spirit explodes: each creature within 5 feet of it must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or take 1d6 force damage.
WildSurge.WildMagicDamageDescription: Until your rage ends, whenever a creature hits you with an attack roll, that creature takes 1d6 force damage as magic lashes out in retribution.
WildSurge.FlowersAndVinesDescription: Flowers and vines temporarily grow around you. Until your rage ends, the ground within 15 feet of you is difficult terrain for your enemies.
WildSurge.BoltOfLightDescription: Until your rage ends, you can use a bonus action on each of your turns to shoot another bolt of light from your chest: a creature of your choice within 30 feet must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or take 1d6 radiant damage and be blinded until the start of your next turn.

SpellMap.Title: Beyond20 Spell Name Mappings
SpellMap.MenuHint: Map D&D Beyond spell names to the matching spell names on your Foundry character sheets, for spells the Cast Spell button can't find by name.
SpellMap.Help: Map a D&D Beyond spell name (left) to the spell's name on the Foundry character sheet (right). Matching ignores case. Leave nothing blank; incomplete rows are discarded on save.

Config.MenuHint: Set and validate the D&D Beyond cobalt session cookie used for imports.
Config.Title: D&D Beyond — Cobalt Cookie
Config.CobaltHint: Paste the value of your dndbeyond.com CobaltSession cookie. Stored for this world.
Config.CobaltSet: A cobalt cookie is currently saved.
Config.RequestBanner: {name} is requesting a D&D Beyond character import. Enter your cobalt session cookie to run it for them.
Config.ValidBad: That doesn't look like a CobaltSession cookie. Paste the CobaltSession value (it contains a '..'), not the cobalt-token / bearer.
Config.ValidFormatOk: Format looks valid. Live validation runs once the import proxy is configured.
Config.ValidAuth: D&D Beyond rejected the cobalt — it may be expired.

Import.Title: Import from D&D Beyond
Import.EditionMismatchBody: This world's dnd5e system is set to {active} rules, but the following imported content uses a different edition:

Error.invalid-id: That doesn't look like a D&D Beyond character URL or ID.
Error.no-proxy: The import proxy isn't configured yet.
Error.no-cobalt: No cobalt session cookie is saved. Add one in the D&D Beyond Importer settings.
Error.bad-cobalt: The saved cobalt cookie doesn't look valid. Re-paste it in the settings.
Error.auth: D&D Beyond rejected the session. Your cobalt cookie may be expired — grab a fresh one and save it again.
Error.not-found: That character wasn't found. Check the URL/ID, and that the character is shared or owned by your account.
Error.ddb: D&D Beyond returned an error for that character.
Error.http: The proxy returned an unexpected response.
Error.bad-response: The proxy response wasn't valid character data.
Error.no-importer: No Game Master is online to run the import.
Error.no-actor: Couldn't find that character actor on the server.
Error.declined: The GM didn't enter a cobalt cookie, so the import was cancelled.

DdbImporter.Title: DDB-Importer Recommended
DdbImporter.Message: Beyond its D&D Beyond concentration integration, Combat Spell Timer relies heavily on the images, actor features, and items created by the DDB-Importer module. Without it, many features and items may not be detected or displayed correctly.

PushingAttack.NoTargets: Pushing Attack: no targets selected or controlled — select or control a token and try again.

WeaponMastery.CleaveDescription: This is the extra attack granted by the Cleave weapon mastery property: if the original attack hit, you can make this attack against a second creature within 5 feet of the first and also within your reach. If it hits, its damage doesn't include your ability modifier unless that modifier is negative.
WeaponMastery.ToppleNoTarget: Topple: no target selected — select the creature you hit and try again.
